title: Rigid motions preserve openness and the local C^{q,alpha} class
statement: Let n, l be natural numbers, U an open subset of R^(n+l), h : R^(n+l) -> R^(n+l), q a natural number, alpha real, xi in R^(n+l) and Q a linear isometry equivalence of R^(n+l). Put T(y) := Q(y - xi), O := T(U) and F(z) := Q(h(xi + Q^{-1} z)). If h is locally C^{q,alpha} in U (IsLocallyHolderCkα q alpha h U: h is C^q on U and for every compact K contained in U there is C with |D^q h(a) - D^q h(b)| <= C |a - b|^alpha for a, b in K), then O is open and F is locally C^{q,alpha} in O.
lean_statement: ∀ n ℓ : ℕ, ∀ (U : Set (Amb n ℓ)), IsOpen U → ∀ (h : Amb n ℓ → Amb n ℓ) (q : ℕ) (α : ℝ) (ξ : Amb n ℓ) (Q : Amb n ℓ ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] Amb n ℓ), IsLocallyHolderCkα q α h U → IsOpen ((fun y => Q (y - ξ)) '' U) ∧ IsLocallyHolderCkα q α (fun z => Q (h (ξ + Q.symm z))) ((fun y => Q (y - ξ)) '' U)
